scope.description: Production Delivery Planner editable scenario-control mutations, semantic discovery, formula propagation, feasibility, and verifier authority.

resolvedFindings.before: The reference production plan used +0 times the capacity control, while the checkpoint only observed available capacity.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The capacity probe is now a binding 0.5 decrease. The verifier proves the baseline would exceed changed capacity, requires changed production, and reruns the full independent feasibility and consistency contract without prescribing a schedule. The reference workbook propagates production into used hours, fulfillment, BOM consumption, rolling inventories, costs, and exceptions.

assertions: Demand mutation changes every semantically discovered order projection and full conservation is reverified.
Capacity mutation is demonstrably binding, changes production, and requires every changed week to satisfy independent capacity and full model checks; no exact allocation or utilization is required.
Supplier lead-time adjustment changes purchase decisions and full receipt legality is reverified.
Expedite-disabled mutation changes purchases, permits no expedited row, and full cost/inventory/date consistency is reverified.
Scenario controls are located by semantic headers and stable control identifiers, without sheet names, coordinates, or reference-workbook matching.
A +0*control reference can no longer satisfy the capacity checkpoint.
limitations: Manifest snapshot/verifier digests remain intentionally stale until final integration rebind.
Source and smoke evidence do not replace the real 13-entry admission portfolio.
certification: non-certifying until rebind, build, and admission on the final combined source
